src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: Hawaii 2011 Reapportionment Commission, Final Report and Reapportionment Plan, 2012 Supplement (Mar 30, 2012): 'The Congressional reapportionment plan adopted by the Commission on September 26, 2011 was not affected by the Hawaii Supreme Court lawsuits'

Adopted Sept 26, 2011; not touched by the Supreme Court case; used 2012 through 2020. Census cb_2020 files hold the plans the Bureau collected for the 2018 election (116th Congress, 2018 legislative districts, per its user note); this state did not change them before the 2020 election.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2011 legislative plan as revised Mar 8, 2012 (25 Senate districts)

Hawaii 2011 Reapportionment Commission, Final Report and Reapportionment Plan, 2012 Supplement (Mar 30, 2012): the Supreme Court voided the Dec 29, 2011 legislative plan on Jan 4, 2012; the Commission adopted a new legislative plan on Mar 8, 2012

The Commission's first legislative plan (reported Dec 29, 2011) was voided by the Hawaii Supreme Court on Jan 4, 2012 for counting non-permanent residents; the plan adopted Mar 8, 2012 (filed Mar 30) was used 2012 through 2020. Census cb_2020 files hold the plans the Bureau collected for the 2018 election (116th Congress, 2018 legislative districts, per its user note); this state did not change them before the 2020 election.

Same revision as the Senate. Census cb_2020 files hold the plans the Bureau collected for the 2018 election (116th Congress, 2018 legislative districts, per its user note); this state did not change them before the 2020 election.
